run_googletest_list_tests: run the googletest-list-tests-unittest_ executable with args and return the list of tests printed
test_default_behavior: test the default behavior of gtest_list_tests when the flag is not set
test_list_tests_flag: test using the gtest_list_tests flag with values 0 and 1
test_override_non_filter_flags: test that gtest_list_tests overrides non-filter flags like gtest_break_on_failure
test_with_filter_flags: test that gtest_list_tests takes into account the gtest_filter flag
